_about: Third-party asset packs for Fogwright. fetch.py downloads them from their itch.io pages into a folder outside the repo. 'repo' says whether the files may be committed to this public repository: CC0 packs may; packs that forbid redistribution may only ship inside the game (with any credit they require).

packs.name: Lowpoly Medieval Weapons
packs.licence: CC0 1.0 (stated on the itch.io page; no licence file in the zip)

packs.name: Post-Apocalyptic World
packs.licence: Atomic Realm licence: commercial use and editing allowed; no repackaging, resale or redistribution, however modified; credit required (link https://atomicrealm.itch.io/)
packs.note: Free sample version; for the more modern, industrial elements

packs.name: Modular Village Pack
packs.note: Fertile Soil Productions; pairs with their Modular Terrain Pack

packs.name: Medieval Interior Asset Pack
packs.licence: No formal licence; the author (SOI) says 'free to use for any purpose' in the comments. Kept out of the repo to be safe.
packs.note: 38 PBR tavern interior assets with collision meshes

packs.name: Horror Texture Pack
packs.note: Screaming Brain Studios; grime, rust and rot for darker, Fog-touched places

packs.name: PSX Style Walls and Fences
packs.licence: CC0 (stated on the page; its textures are CC0 too)

packs.name: Tiny Texture Pack 3
packs.note: Screaming Brain Studios; small tiling textures (stone, ground)

packs.name: Basic Motions FREE
packs.licence: No licence stated on the page; the author (Kevin Iglesias) asks for credit as a link to www.keviniglesias.com. Kept out of the repo.

packs.name: Western Props Pack
packs.licence: Dev Assets (Brackeys) guidelines: free for commercial and non-commercial use, no credit needed; may only be distributed as part of a game, never as raw files. Kept out of the repo.
packs.note: Free tier; low poly, hand-painted, one atlas texture
